description: Requirements carry one or more capability slugs on their existing free-form tags array using the convention capability:<kebab-slug>. A capability taxonomy for the rcf-lite product itself is documented in the rcf-lite docs, alongside the rule for adding a new capability. This is a convention that rides on the shipped schema; no schema change. The Product Map by-capability grouping is the consumer that proves the convention works on real data.
title: Capability tag convention on requirements
rationale: Analysis d-019 established that the shipped schema has no capability or feature level between PRD and REQ. The trial answers whether a lightweight convention on the existing tags array carries a usable product taxonomy without a schema change. If the tags and the by-capability view earn their keep, the capability level is promoted to a proper schema field later; if not, nothing was spent.
